3º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 5

Daily routines

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Name the actions we do every day
  • Say the time with o'clock and half past
  • Talk about your day with I + verb and the time
  • Put the actions of the day in order with first, then and after that

Para pensar

Cada mañana haces casi lo mismo: te despiertas, te levantas, te lavas, desayunas… ¿Cómo se llama eso en inglés y cómo lo contarías?

Explicación

What is a routine?

A routine is what we do every day, more or less at the same time. We wake up, eat, go to school, play and sleep. Routines help our body: we sleep better and we learn better.

En castellano: daily significa «diario, de cada día». Para hablar de rutinas usamos el presente, que en inglés se llama present simple: «I get up», «I go to school». Es como en español: «me levanto», «voy al cole».

Morning actions

In the morning we do these actions: wake up (despertarse), get up (levantarse), have a shower (ducharse), wash my face (lavarme la cara), brush my teeth (lavarme los dientes), get dressed (vestirme), have breakfast (desayunar) and go to school (ir al cole).

Act them out with your class! Mime each action while you say it: «I brush my teeth» (mueve la mano como un cepillo). Ojo: wake up es abrir los ojos y get up es salir de la cama.

Afternoon and evening actions

In the afternoon: have lunch (comer), go home (ir a casa), do my homework (hacer los deberes), play with my friends (jugar con mis amigos), go to the park and have a snack (merendar).

In the evening: have a bath (bañarse), have dinner (cenar), watch TV, read a book, put on my pyjamas and go to bed (acostarse). Truco: muchas comidas usan have: have breakfast, have lunch, have dinner.

What time is it? O'clock

To say the time, ask: What time is it? (¿qué hora es?). When the long hand points to 12, we say o'clock (en punto): «It's seven o'clock», «It's three o'clock».

To say when we do something, use at: «I get up at seven o'clock», «I have lunch at two o'clock». En castellano: «a las siete» se dice «at seven». No hace falta poner «the»: nunca digas «at the seven».

Half past

When the long hand points to 6, half an hour has passed. In English we say half past (y media) + the hour: «It's half past eight» (las ocho y media), «I go to school at half past eight».

Ojo: en inglés el orden es «media pasada de las ocho». Para practicar, mira un reloj de verdad cada media hora y di la hora en voz alta: «It's half past four! Time for a snack!».

My day in sentences

Now join the action and the time: I + action + at + time. «I wake up at seven o'clock. I have breakfast at half past seven. I go to school at half past eight. I have lunch at two o'clock. I go to bed at nine o'clock.»

Use in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening and at night for parts of the day: «I do my homework in the afternoon.» «I read a book at night.»

First, then, after that

To tell your routine in order, use sequence words: First (primero), then (luego), after that (después de eso) and finally (por último).

«First, I get up. Then, I wash my face. After that, I get dressed and have breakfast. Finally, I go to school.» These words make your text clear and easy to follow. Ponlas al principio de la frase y después una coma.

Reading: Ana's Saturday

Read: «On Saturdays my routine is different! I wake up at nine o'clock. First, I have a big breakfast with my family: pancakes! Then, at half past ten, I go to the swimming pool with my dad. After that, I have lunch at my grandma's house at two o'clock. In the afternoon I play with my cousins in the park. I have dinner at eight o'clock and I go to bed at half past nine.»

Answer: What time does Ana wake up? Where does she have lunch?

Let's practise: my routine clock

Make a routine clock. Draw a big circle on a card and divide it into parts: morning, afternoon, evening and night. In each part, draw what you do and write the sentence: «I have lunch at two o'clock».

Then interview a partner: «What time do you get up?» — «I get up at half past seven.» «What time do you go to bed?» — «At nine o'clock.» Compare: ¿quién se levanta antes? ¿Quién duerme más horas?

My daily routine

Ejercicios

  1. Traduce: levantarse, vestirse, desayunar.

  2. ¿Cómo se dice «cenar»?

  3. ¿Cómo se dice «hacer los deberes»?

  4. Escribe en inglés: 9:00.

  5. Escribe en inglés: 2:30.

  6. Completa: «I go to bed ___ nine o'clock.»

  7. Completa: «I do my homework in the ___.» (tarde)

  8. Pregunta a qué hora se levanta tu amigo.

  9. Ordena con First, Then, Finally: ir al cole, desayunar, levantarse.

  10. Escribe tres frases de tu rutina con la hora.

Practica

  1. «Levantarse» is…

    1. A) go to bed
    2. B) get up
    3. C) get dressed

  2. «Lavarse los dientes» is…

    1. A) brush my teeth
    2. B) wash my teeth
    3. C) clean my mouth

  3. «Cenar» is…

    1. A) have lunch
    2. B) have breakfast
    3. C) have dinner

  4. 7:00 is…

    1. A) half past seven
    2. B) seven half
    3. C) seven o'clock

  5. 6:30 is…

    1. A) half past six
    2. B) six o'clock
    3. C) half past seven

  6. I get up ___ eight o'clock.

    1. A) in
    2. B) at
    3. C) on

  7. I do my homework ___ the afternoon.

    1. A) in
    2. B) at
    3. C) on

  8. «Primero» is…

    1. A) then
    2. B) finally
    3. C) first

  9. «Por último» is…

    1. A) first
    2. B) finally
    3. C) after

  10. «What time is it?» means…

    1. A) ¿qué tiempo hace?
    2. B) ¿qué hora es?
    3. C) ¿cuánto tiempo?

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: Qué es una rutina diaria; Qué acciones hago por la mañana, la tarde y la noche; Cómo digo la hora con o'clock y half past; Cómo cuento mi día en orden con first, then y finally.

Resumen

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

daily routineRutina diaria.
get upLevantarse.
brush my teethLavarme los dientes.
have breakfast / lunch / dinnerDesayunar / comer / cenar.
do my homeworkHacer los deberes.
o'clockEn punto: seven o'clock.
half pastY media: half past seven.
first, then, finallyPrimero, luego, por último.

Soluciones

  1. B) Get up.
  2. A) Brush.
  3. C) Dinner.
  4. C) En punto.
  5. A) Y media.
  6. B) At + hora.
  7. A) In the afternoon.
  8. C) First.
  9. B) Finally.
  10. B) La hora.

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. get up, get dressed, have breakfast.
  2. have dinner.
  3. do my homework.
  4. nine o'clock.
  5. half past two.
  6. at.
  7. afternoon.
  8. What time do you get up?
  9. First, I get up. Then, I have breakfast. Finally, I go to school.
  10. Model answer: I get up at seven o'clock. I have lunch at two o'clock. I go to bed at half past nine.
